subject: medicine
title: Bronchiectasis and cystic fibrosis

steps.tx: Ask about daily **purulent sputum** with morning cupfuls, colour change and volumes during **exacerbations**. Note postural drainage routine, **haemoptysis** episodes, sinus blockage with polyps, male **infertility**, and childhood measles, pertussis or tuberculosis that scarred the airways. Count yearly admissions for flare ups and ask about weight loss and night sweats.
steps.say: Ask how much sputum the patient brings up each day, especially first thing in the morning. Note any change in colour or volume during flare ups and count admissions in the past year. Enquire about postural drainage, blood in sputum, blocked sinuses, childhood measles or pertussis, past tuberculosis, and difficulty fathering children.

steps.tx: Inspect fingers for **clubbing** with loss of the nail bed angle, and listen for coarse **crackles** with polyphonic wheeze. Assess nutritional state and growth in children, sniff for nasal **polyps** with anosmia, and look for ankle **oedema** with raised venous pressure in late cor pulmonale.
steps.say: Inspect the fingers for clubbing and loss of the nail bed angle. You should listen for coarse crackles and polyphonic wheeze across the lung fields. Assess nutrition and growth in children, sniff for nasal polyps with loss of smell, and look for ankle swelling with raised venous pressure when cor pulmonale develops.

steps.tx: Study both hands showing bulbous **fingertip clubbing** with an inset of opposed nails where the **Schamroth window** is obliterated. Loss of the nail bed angle marks chronic **suppuration** and longstanding airway sepsis. Link this sign with daily purulent sputum and arrange **sputum culture** with lung imaging.
steps.say: Look at both hands in this photograph. The fingertips appear bulbous, and the inset shows opposed nails with no visible diamond window. This obliterated Schamroth window with loss of the nail bed angle marks chronic suppuration. Link this sign with daily purulent sputum, and arrange sputum culture with lung imaging.

vis.caption: Hands showing clubbing with lost nail bed angle. Illustration: StewardMD original.

steps.tx: Prove bronchiectasis with **HRCT scanning** showing signet ring shadows, tramlines and lack of tapering. Send **sputum culture** for pseudomonas and haemophilus, and order **sweat chloride** testing with genotyping for cystic fibrosis. Add immunoglobulins, ciliary studies, **spirometry** and sinus imaging to complete the workup.
steps.say: Prove bronchiectasis with high resolution CT showing signet ring shadows, tramlines and lack of tapering. Send sputum for culture to detect pseudomonas and haemophilus infection. Order sweat chloride testing with genotyping when cystic fibrosis is suspected. Add immunoglobulins, ciliary studies, spirometry and sinus imaging to complete the workup.

vis.alt: High-resolution CT scan of the chest demonstrating dilated bronchi and thickened walls, characteristic of bronchiectasis.
vis.caption: HRCT showing classic bronchiectasis with signet ring signs. Image: John S. To, MD, CC0/PD, Wikimedia Commons.

steps.tx: Teach daily **airway clearance** with postural drainage, percussion and oscillatory devices. Prescribe long term **azithromycin** to cut exacerbations and **nebulised antibiotics** for chronic pseudomonas infection. Offer yearly flu and pneumococcal vaccines, correct pancreatic insufficiency with enzymes, and refer localised bleeding or end stage disease for surgery or **transplant**.

Prescribe long term azithromycin to cut exacerbations, and add nebulised antibiotics for chronic pseudomonas infection. Offer yearly flu and pneumococcal vaccines, correct pancreatic insufficiency with enzymes, and refer localised bleeding or end stage disease for surgery or transplant.
